Hello, Sensei! I love your designs!! If possible, could you design a logo for my Vtuber, SheRyu?

About my Vtuber:
Dr. SheRyu Benzaiten, a warrior-scholar-archivist VTuber, who visits & studies various worlds and brings back artifacts from them to keep their histories alive! SheRyu is passionate about protecting and passing on history, culture, and civilizations—especially those easily lost to the passage of time. She is kind and warm-hearted and never hesitates to help others. However, SheRyu is also a warrior, with  speed, stealth, and skill, often wielding dual katanas in combat. Despite her gentle nature, Sheryu will enter battle without hesitation to protect those she holds dear. 

Please design a logo that captures her spirit through both the font and motifs! If possible, I'd like for the logo to only include "SheRyu" so it stays simple! I'd also love it if you could make the main text in English and add the Japanese name as well! Thank you so much!!
